summary: 27 India and the World: Land and the People 2 – Understanding the Weather Understanding the Weather CHAPTER 2 A change in the weather is sufficient to create the world and oneself anew. How can we measure and monitor the weather around us? How do weather predictions help us prepare for events like heavy rain, storms, drought and heat waves? 28 Exploring Society: India and Beyond | Grade 7 Part 1 Weather and its Elements You wake up one winter morning and shiver. You reach for thick clothes to keep yourself warm. In the summer, you choose clothes that keep you cool and comfortable. You are responding to your body’s signals; your body is sensing the weather. Weather is a state of the Earth’s atmosphere at a particular time and place. In simple terms, it is the layer of gases that surround some planets — in the case of our Earth, we call these gases ‘air’. The Earth’s atmosphere may be compared to a cake with several layers.
